chunks: And from him, from Sa'd ibn Abdillah, from Ahmad ibn al-Husayn ibn Sa'id, from his father, from Muhammad ibn Sulayman al-Basri, from his father, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:
In the clay of the grave of al-Husayn (peace be upon him) is the cure from every disease, and it is the greatest medicine.
ai.seo_question: What is the spiritual and physical significance of the clay from the grave of Imam al-Husayn?
ai.summary: In Kamil al-Ziyarat, Ibn Qulawayh transmits a chain of authority linking Imam al-Sadiq (a.s.) to the profound spiritual and physical efficacy of the soil from Imam al-Husayn’s (a.s.) grave. This tradition elevates the clay from mere earth to the 'greatest medicine' (ad-dawa' al-akbar), reflecting the Shia belief in the intercessory power and enduring sanctity of the Ahl al-Bayt even in their physical remains. Such narrations underscore the concept of 'shifa' (cure) as both a literal healing and a spiritual remedy derived from the proximity to the Imams.
